name: Meteor Alignment
description: Matching natural Falling Star Power dice and a natural Power total of 7 add Power before Accuracy resolves.
levelUpLine: lvl 41 Mastery ☄️ Meteor Alignment: Falling Star's Power dice can form a Meteor Alignment. If two Power dice match, add +10 Power. If all three Power dice match, add +20 Power instead. If the three Power dice total exactly 7, add +15 Power.
